notes: The spec says <<- removes leading spaces without saying which characters count as spaces: Comments and Whitespace treats tabs as whitespace as well as U+0020, and Template Literals interprets space characters by Unicode's definition for strip markers. hashicorp/hcl counts any leading Unicode whitespace, tabs included, as one character of indentation (flushHeredocTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go uses unicode.IsSpace). If only U+0020 counted, nothing would be removed.
